name: Midwinterhoornblazen (Twente midwinter horn blowing)
lineage: Seasonal custom of the Twente and Achterhoek regions in the eastern Netherlands, in which players blow the midwinterhoorn, a curved, end-blown wooden horn about a metre long, from the start of Advent to Epiphany. Players often blow their calls over the opening of a farmyard well, which carries the sound across the fields, and local groups and competitions keep the custom, which is listed in the Dutch national inventory of intangible heritage; the tautari card stands in for the midwinterhoorn.
recipe: classic modern midwinterhoornblazen, drone Modal, wind pipe branch. tautari. open air. ORTF stereo pair, portable field-recorder pre. 24-bit digital.
